title: A benchmarks.py run leaves its run-<pid>-<hex> scratch directory behind, a --dry-run too, and the directories are not tidy records so they accumulate
goal: Bench.close removes the run's own scratch directory when it holds no raw log worth keeping, and a --dry-run makes none, or backlog.py tidy lists the leftover run directories as its own records

run:
import os, subprocess, sys, tempfile
t = tempfile.mkdtemp()
subprocess.run([sys.executable, "_tools/benchmarks.py", "run", "pool", "--dry-run", "--sample", "1"], capture_output=True, env=dict(os.environ, BENCH_SCRATCH=t))
left = [n for n in os.listdir(t) if n.startswith("run-")]
print(left); sys.exit(1 if left else 0)
